Name: Normal and Yandere Seasonal Elliott Portraits for Portraiture
Author: RurinaRirimu
Description:
[size=3]Greatly inspired by the Amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14270]Yandere Elliott Portrait Mod[/url] by [b]NinTheCactus69 [/b][/size][size=2][i](As of 6/30/24, it's down for maint, but please check out his work when it's back up!)[/i][/size][size=3]

And of course, the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8807]Yandere Elliott Dialogue Expansion Mod[/url] lovingly translated by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/71439403]Kxgarashii[/url] [/size][size=2][i](this version is broken by 1.6 but you can find an unofficial fix in the posts section. Along with a support server, where I was aided in making this mod. You can join the support server, where you can download the fix, [url=https://discord.com/invite/G8nxxW8T7F]here![/url])

[/i][/size][size=3]Seasonal outfits are taken from the beautiful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic Mod[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url][/size][size=2][i]


[/i][/size]
[center]Hey you, yeah, you right there. You like Elliott? Think he's a gorgeous beautiful man? Want to see this gorgeous beautiful man in HD with some of the best seasonal outfits on Nexus? [i][size=1](In my opinion) [/size][/i][size=3]Then look no further![/size]

I have taken the liberty to draw our elegant little writer in my own personal style. Adding seasonal earrings where I felt the need. It does not include every seasonal outfit in Poltergeister's mod, but if you want matching sprites, grab the appropriate ones from their page! I could do all outfits at a later date, though I might edit them slightly [i][size=1](I'm looking at you, Egghunt shirt. what is that??)

[/size][/i]Since I was greatly inspired by the wide range of emotions, and honestly just how batshit insane Elliott looked inside of Nin's mod, I have included a veritable plethora of expressions I hope can compare. I also did do a portrait version of his amazing Spirit's Eve outfit. However, I cannot and will not supply you with his sprite matching it. It's purely if you already have his mod on hand, and want the matching portrait for that particular outfit. Along with a patch file lovingly made by my good friend Auri ([url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sectonia/about-me]@Sectonia[/url]﻿) for the yandere mod itself, so my portraits display properly. [size=3][i](THE PATCH FILE IS FOR THIS PORTRAIT ONLY)[/i][/size] You need only install which version of Elliott you want [i](Medicated or Unmedicated)[/i][/center]

[size=4][b]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Make sure you have [b]Portraiture[/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Make double sure you have [b]Portraiture Plus[/b] (which is installed as another separate mod)[/size]
[*][size=3]Extract the folder with your chosen portraits into [b]Portraiture/Portraits[/b][/size]
[/list][size=3][i](Next steps for Yandere ver only)[b]
[/b][/i][/size][list]
[*][size=3]If using the Yandere mod, extract Auri's patch into the [b][CP] Yandere Elliott Expansion[/b] folder (it should overwrite)[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Run the game, if Elliott is fresh and fine, you're done!![/size]
[*][size=3][i]A Winner is You!!![/i][/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][center]
[size=3]Want more portraits? Good news!! I'm already working on a Sebastian version for the Yandere Sebastian mod. I have no ETA sadly, as my health is very very poor. I don't do commissions for that reason, however, you can support me at [url=https://ko-fi.com/rurinadraws]Ko-fi[/url]﻿. I plan to set goals to do more portraits, starting with the other bachelors, bachelorettes, and then villagers. I don't want to put too high of a price on these goals, so each and every single one will be $50. If just 10 people give me $5. I'm gonna get it done. So far, I plan for every single one to be seasonal, based on Poltergeister's outfits more or less. If you want me to prioritize anyone in particular, or create yandere versions for other love interests [i](since only Sebastian and Elliott are planned)[/i], or you want more outfits, or you simply just want portraits for other mods [i](such as Sword and Sorcery)[/i]. Reach out!! I really don't mind, as long as you mind the fact that I can't guarantee any release schedule. I'll always be guaranteed 100% to do something, eventually, if you buy me a ko-fi. I want to give back for the support.
[/size]
[i]Quickest way to reach me will always be on discord, my username is [b]rurinaririmu.[/b][/i][/center]


[i][left]Pre-emptive Troubleshooting:
With Portraiture Plus, having portraits change on location/weather/time/festivals is easy. However, this means that the usual _Beach portrait has been lovingly renamed to just _IslandSouth. As whenever Elliott was on the beach, just the location, no matter what season, he'd be bare-chested. This unfortunately was leading to many cardiac arrests, and I can't keep affording everyone's medical bills. So unless you're using something else, its best to keep it as _IslandSouth. In the case of breaking seasonal flags, I have included Elliott's default fall outfit as a separate file just with the vanilla portrait name. You probably won't need it, but I put it for both versions all the same[/left][/i]
